Cluster Autoscaling Strategies

The cluster autoscaler automatically adjusts the size of the Kubernetes cluster when pods fail to schedule.

Scale Down Policies

Nodes are considered unneeded when utilization drops below 50 percent for more than 10 minutes.

SettingDefaultDescription
scale-down-unneeded-time10mTime node must be unneeded before scale down
max-nodes-total100Maximum aggregate worker nodes
 
kubectl logs -n kube-system deployment/cluster-autoscaler
